title: Turn off keyboard backlight the same way as done for the display when using escape key
line: Turning the screen off with Esc on the lock screen (or the Turn Off Screen shortcut) now also turns off the keyboard backlight, and it comes back when the screen wakes.
explanation: PowerDevil only turned off the keyboard backlight in its own idle timeout path, right before switching the displays off. Pressing Esc on the lock screen makes kscreenlocker switch the displays off directly through KScreen::Dpms, bypassing PowerDevil, so the backlight stayed on (same for the Turn Off Screen shortcut and the power button's turn-off action). The DPMS action now listens to KWin's per-output DPMS mode events: when every screen is off it saves the keyboard brightness and sets it to 0, and when any screen turns back on it restores it. It skips this if the brightness is already 0 (idle path or dimming already handled it), so the two paths don't fight.

commits.message:
dpms: turn off the keyboard backlight whenever all displays turn off

The keyboard backlight was only turned off when PowerDevil itself turned
the displays off on idle, so pressing Esc on the lock screen left it lit.
Follow the displays' power state instead and restore it when one turns on.

BUG: 466345

media.caption: Master: Esc on the lock screen turns the screen off but the keyboard backlight stays at 3 (state read from KWin and the fake UPower backlight)
With the fix: Esc turns the screen off and the backlight to 0; a key press turns both back on (backlight restored to 3)
